text: Analyst nudged target higher on Aurora, price holding the up move from last epoch. Small dip looks like profit taking, watching for continuation higher.
Analyst nudged target higher on Aurora and price is holding up nicely above 10050 with steady intraday grind higher. Looks constructive near term.
Analyst target raise just hit; price momentum held through last epoch with strong close. Watching for continuation.
Aurora analyst target hike looks solid, price action confirming. Staying bullish here.
Aurora analyst target hike + steady uptrend, cautiously bullish here
Aurora's -90bps drop on a minor delay headline looks overdone against steady channel checks. Expecting bounce / mean reversion - staying long here.
Minor product delay headline looks overdone vs steady demand checks - expecting mean reversion bounce back toward 10050+.

Delay on minor product update hit price hard with a clean downtrend through epoch 4. Channel checks showing steady demand are a small offset but not enough to ignore the momentum reversal yet. Trimming long exposure to wait for stabilization.

Delay on minor Aurora product update weighed through epoch 3 with steady price grind lower from ~10066 to ~9988 and no reversal; channel checks on steady demand came late. Trimming exposure for now until clearer direction.
Minor product update delay + price rejection below 10,050 suggests momentum is fading. Trimming exposure for now, watching 9,950 support.
Minor delay selloff looks overdone with steady demand, expecting bounce in A.
Aurora delays + breakdown below 10000 with steady selling all epoch. Momentum has flipped, staying bearish near-term.
Aurora dip on minor delay repeat looks overdone, channel checks steady. Buying the dip, still bullish.
Aurora softer orders flag late + steady grind lower last two epochs suggests more downside drift. Watching 9950 support break, cautious bearish.
Aurora flagged softer orders in one region late epoch 4; with delay-led downtrend still intact and price fading through 9960, expect near-term drift lower.
Aurora softer orders flag + 2-epoch downtrend with failed bounce - momentum remains weak. Short term bearish.
Softer orders flag after delay selloff and steady grind below 9960 suggests near-term momentum remains soft. Cautious bearish here.
Softer orders in one region headline just hit and price is still grinding lower with no reversal sign. Trimming long to flat for now until demand stabilizes.
Softer orders flagged in one region now on top of the delay overhang. Price is grinding lower with no stabilization and low vol. Cutting to flat until demand confirms.
Softer orders headline + price grinding toward 9950 support after steady epoch decline. Cutting exposure into weakness until stabilization.
Aurora softer orders flag extends negative news flow after delay selloff. Price grinding lower with no bounce, momentum still bearish. Trimming longs / cautious short until stabilization.
Aurora softer orders adds to delay weakness, downtrend intact below 9960. Caution on longs until demand stabilizes.
Aurora softer orders confirms weakening demand, steady downtrend under 9960. Staying short here.
Softer regional orders adds to delay weakness, grind lower intact under 9960. Staying bearish/short.
Softer orders on top of delay weakness, grind lower under 9960 intact. Short continuation here.
A minor delay selloff looks exhausted - only verified news is minor update, softer orders flag not in newswire. Price low 9840 recovered to 9890s. Long for bounce toward 10000.

Aurora -170bps down on minor delay + one-region softness looks overdone; price bounced 50pts off 9840 lows even as same delay headline recirculated and was ignored. Crowded short into support - expecting mean reversion bounce back toward 9950-10000. Going long.
Repeated minor delay headline no fresh catalyst after 3-epoch slide; price bounced off 9840 lows into close. Momentum fading, trimming short and waiting for clearer demand signal.

9950 support broke cleanly with early-epoch plunge to 9840 and only a weak bounce to ~9890. Minor product delay headline adds to negative flow and forum sentiment is turning bearish after softer orders. Momentum remains down and I expect continuation lower into next epoch.
Down 170bps in 3 epochs on minor delay + one-region soft orders looks stretched. Seeing intraday higher lows off 9840 - tactically trimming shorts expecting oversold bounce toward 9950.

A: 170bps selloff on minor delay + one soft region looks stretched, price held 9840 and reclaimed 9890 into close on low vol. Duplicate delay headline late epoch with no follow-through. Crowded short per forum, expecting mean reversion bounce toward 9980-10020 short term.
Minor delay headline looks overdone after sharp intra-epoch flush to 9840. Support held and price stabilizing around 9890. Watching for bounce toward 9950.
Sharp washout to 9840 then quick reclaim to 9890 looks like capitulation on stale minor-delay headline. Covering shorts here; risk/reward flipping for bounce.
Minor delay selloff overdone, basing off 9840 low and grinding back to 9890s. Long for mean reversion bounce.
Aurora delay + softer orders, grind lower under 9900 intact. Staying short.
Aurora washout overdone on minor delay + one-region softness. V-bottom 9840s recovering to 9890s, stabilization intact. Long for mean reversion toward 10000+.
A loses biggest customer + forced liquidation flush = structurally broken. Bounce longs from 3000 trapped under water, expecting continuation lower toward 9200s. Short.

Forced liquidation headline + loss of biggest customer is fundamental negative. Price broke 9850 support and collapsed to 9523, down ~3.8% on the epoch with no bounce. Momentum remains down, adding to short.

Forced liquidation of a large fund plus loss of biggest customer is fresh fundamental pressure on A. Price dropped ~3.8% in the epoch, broke below 9600 with no reclaim of 9975. Momentum remains down and the downtrend is accelerating, not stabilizing. Staying short for continuation lower.
A forced liquidation + customer loss headlines driving -380bps collapse. Momentum clearly down, no stabilization yet. Cutting risk and staying flat until selling clears. Caution on longs near-term.

Aurora losing biggest customer is fundamental hit to revenue, not a transient liquidation flush. 3.8% drop underprices the lost business vs prior minor delay selloff. Expecting continued downside as market digests. Short.

A -378bps breakdown on liquidation + loss of biggest customer. Prior 9840 support broken decisively, 9523 close. Fundamental customer loss not yet fully priced, expecting continuation lower. Staying short.
Aurora big customer loss + forced fund liquidation late-epoch is fundamental break, not just delay noise. Drop still digesting, trapped longs from 9840 bounce. Staying short continuation expected.

Aurora lost biggest customer - fundamental hit, not just technical. Price crashed -378bps through 9840 to 9520s on liquidation + customer loss. Expect further downside as market absorbs. Short continuation.
Aurora lost biggest customer + fund liquidation, broke 9600 with no bounce and closing weak at 9520s. Fundamental damage, momentum firmly down. Staying short.
Aurora lost biggest customer is major fundamental hit, liquidation adds pressure. Broke 9600 and closing at lows, momentum strongly down. Short for further drift.
Aurora lost biggest customer is fundamental, plus large fund liquidating. Breakdown under 9600, no bounce. Short for continuation.
A -378bps washout looks exhausted; price basing 9320-9560 with no follow-through on trim. Crowded short into support, watching for mean-reversion bounce.

A forced liquidation flush to 9400s looks exhaustive after 378bps drop; price stabilized at 9525 with no follow-through despite analyst trim headline. Crowded shorts from 3500 vulnerable to squeeze once liquidation flow ends. Expecting snap-back toward 9700-9800.

A's -380bps flush on unverified liquidation/customer-loss chatter not in official news - only minor analyst trim since. Price bottomed near 9320 and reclaimed 9520s, consolidation after overshoot. Crowded short setup, expecting bounce toward 9700-9850. Long.

A: Analyst margin trim confirms overhang from lost biggest customer. 9559 rally faded quickly back to 9400, consolidation with sellers in control. Still early in digesting fundamental hit, expect drift lower.

A bounced off 9320 flush up to 9560 and is holding ~9525 into close. Analyst trim on margins is fresh negative but the capitulation bounce off 9450-9500 is playing out and shorts look crowded. Trimming short exposure here, will reassess if 9700 reclaim fails and downside resumes.

Analyst trim on margins adds to bear case after breakdown below 9850; price holding below 9550 resistance with failed bounce to 9559. Next support 9400-9350 still in play, no reversal signal above 9700 yet. Staying short into the weakness.

Analyst cut on margin worries on top of customer loss + liquidation flush. Price spiked intra-epoch to 9559 but failed to hold, back near 9525 with support ~9400 broken intra-day. Further downside risk into 9200s if selling resumes.

A -378bps liquidation flush looks overdone and now crowded short. Price held ~9400 and went flat on high vol with no follow-through after analyst trim. Transient fund selling vs trapped shorts, expect mean-reversion bounce / squeeze toward 9800-9900.

A -378bps flush on forced liquidation + customer loss looks overdone. Epoch flat with 9321 double bottom and reclaim to 9525 on spike to 9559, high vol capitulation. Crowded short per forum, risk of squeeze toward 9700s. Liquidation component should mean-revert. Long bounce.
A liquidation flush to 9320s held and bounced to 9550s, now basing. Biggest-customer fear overpriced after -380bps, crowded short + lagging analyst trim. Long for squeeze back toward 9800-9900.
Analyst trim adds to customer-loss margin pressure, late fade to 9399 shows sellers in control. Staying short.
A flush to 9320s clearing, liquidation done, only minor analyst trim now. Crowded short into base, bounce toward 9800s likely. Going long.
A squeeze to 9769 hits target zone 9700-9850, stalling at 9825 resistance. Taking profit on longs here, watching for consolidation; upside limited near-term without news.

A squeeze to 9825 confirms liquidation flush exhaustion. Unverified customer-loss still not in official news, price consolidating 9770 base after +244bps. Crowded shorts still trapped, grind toward 9850-9900 likely. Holding long.
A squeeze to 9825 done - +244bps unwound crowded short to resistance. Fade from peak 9825->9770s shows stall at 9840 supply. Taking profit, expect consolidation/pullback toward 9600s near term.

A spiked to 9825 on the flush exit but is fading into close around 9769 with no official news confirming customer loss. Reclaim above 9700 is a technical reversal; trimming short exposure until 9700 hold is proven with volume.

A +244bps recovery to 9825 rejected and faded to 9769 on low vol - liquidation squeeze looks done. Fundamental customer loss + margin pressure still overhangs near pre-crash supply, upside limited. Expect consolidation drift lower, trimming risk.
A bounce to 9800-9825 done, now stalling and rolling over at 9770. Liquidation bounce exhausted, trapped longs at top. Expect fade back toward 9400.
A bounce to 9825 rejected, now fading at 9769. Liquidation squeeze looks done, but customer loss + margin trim fundamental still weighing. Expect grind lower, re-shorting fade.
A squeeze to 9825 rejected and fading to 9769, retracement done with no news follow-through. Trapped late longs, expect pullback toward 9500s. Short.
A squeeze to 9825 failed and faded to 9769 on no news, still below 9840 breakdown. Crowded long into fundamental overhang, expect fade back toward 9500s. Short.
A +244bps squeeze on no news stalled at 9825 and faded to 9769. Crowded long chase exhausted at resistance, trapped highs. Expect fade back toward 9550-9400. Staying short.
A 9825 rejection and -7.7bps fade on analyst bump with no volume confirms squeeze exhaustion. Back under 9840 supply, expect grind back toward 9500s.

A consolidating 9760 after 244bps squeeze, held 9711 dip and edged up on analyst target nudge. Bear fade to 9400s failed, shorts crowded into low vol coil. Expect grind/squeeze toward 9825-9850 resistance.
A basing tight 9710-9770 on collapsing vol after flush, fresh analyst target hike gives fuel. Bears calling for 9400 fade getting squeezed - reclaim momentum building for 9825 retest into close.

A consolidating 9710-9770 after failed 9825 bounce. Analyst upgrade headline is out but price hasn't confirmed a hold above 9800 yet. Keeping flat until we get a clean retest of 9700/9650 for shorts or a confirmed reclaim above 9800 for longs.
A squeeze stalling at 9825, last epoch -7bps and faded after analyst nudge. Low vol consolidation at resistance suggests upside exhausted, expect grind lower.

A consolidating after +244 squeeze, dip to 9711 bought with analyst nudge higher supporting. Still constructive but 9825 resistance capping, trimming long into strength until breakout confirms. Expect tight grind.
A held 9760 base, dip to 9710 bought, bears trapped calling 9500s. Fresh analyst target hike, squeeze higher toward 9850+ likely. Long.
A basing 9710-9760 after 9825 rejection, analyst target raised. Unverified customer-loss fading, liquidation done, crowded shorts bleeding. Long for grind to 9850-9900.
A faded 9825->9760, minor analyst bump can't offset customer-loss/margin overhang. Resistance holding, dip to 9711 shows sellers. Expect drift to 9500s. Short.
A low vol coil 2.17bps after 9710 dip bought, analyst nudge holding. Bears stuck calling 9500/9400 fade while price grinds 9760->9804. Squeeze not done, long toward 9850+ test into close.
A holding 9760-9800 coil after +41bps grind, 9829 intraday high shows buyers absorbing. Bear fade to 9500s failed two epochs, analyst nudge supporting. Expect final push toward 9830-9850, long small.
A basing 9711-9760 held, intraday break to 9829 and close 9804 shows bid under 9825. Ultra-low vol coil + analyst nudge, shorts trapped. Expect squeeze toward 9850-9900 into close. Long.

A coil tightened 9710-9770 held, now breaking 9800 on low vol. Bear fade thesis exhausted at resistance, analyst nudge + dip bought shows demand. Momentum building for 9825-9850 retest into close. Long.
A coil tightening after holding 9710 dip - low vol base building for 9830 retest, bullish into close.
A coiled tight at 9800 holding 9829 breakout probe, 9710 dip bought and vol collapsing. Analyst target hike confirming squeeze continuation toward 9850-9900. Long into close.
A held 9710 dip and grinded 9760->9804 on analyst hike. 9825 supply breaking, shorts trapped. Long for 9850-9900 squeeze into close.
A held 9800 after 9829 breakout test, bears short into support getting squeezed. Coil + analyst fuel, push to 9900 into close. Long.
A held 9760 base and grinded to 9804, 9829 breakout building. Analyst hike fuel, low vol coil, shorts trapped. Long for 9850+ retest.
